title: "Applied Data Analytics"

## Overview

Course will cover the following:

- data fetching/preprocessing
- causal inference
- reproducibility
- domains:
  - geoscience
  - finance/economics
  - genetics/bioinformatics
  - healthcare
  - knowledge graphs/entity-centric analytics
  - astronomy
